source: lab (real recording, Orbbec Femto Mega RGB; SAM2-demo restyled: background colour-tinted, the 4 balls keep natural colours)

camera.motion: static (phase correlation of the upper-left background vs frame 0: |shift| < 0.06 px in every frame)
camera.view: elevated, tilted down onto a carpeted floor; back wall with cabinet doors on the left, work area with seated person top-right
camera.dropped_capture_frames: container timestamps are uniform, but every moving object jumps ~2x its normal step between frames 35->36, and the basketball also between 11->12: the camera skipped one capture there. Frame indices are kept as-is (t = frame/24) in all files.

perspective.floor_wall_baseboard_bottom_edge: y = -0.3024 x + 388.8 (x 10..610), slope -16.8 deg; band thickness 25 px at x=0 and 11.5 px at x=600 (far end smaller)

floor_tape_near.note: runs off the bottom edge, length is a lower bound

perspective.depth_cue: objects higher in the image are farther away; ball apparent diameters shrink as they move up-left / up-right (see apparent_size)

basketball.desc: orange Wilson basketball, largest ball; starts bottom-centre-right under the crouching person's hand
basketball.path: pushed up-left across the floor from ~(876,666) to the wall/baseboard at ~(400,265) (frame 39), then rebounds slowly down-right to (435,293) at frame 48

soccer_ball.desc: white ball with black pentagons, held on the floor by the crouching person's hand at ~(911,611), right of the basketball

rest_estimate_frames_0_23.how: visual: left edge x~890, top y~584 of the free outline; right half hidden behind the crouching person

soccer_ball.path: static (held) until frame 23, rolls from frame 24 up and slightly left to (835,372) at frame 48, still moving; frames 46-48 drawn as a flat grey disc (segmentation dropout)
soccer_ball.hidden_frames: 13-14 not detected (behind the arm); 10-23 mostly hidden, track there unreliable

yellow_ball.desc: small yellow ball (tennis-ball like) thrown from the left edge together with the white ball; the yellow one is the lower/trailing one early, the right-hand one late
yellow_ball.path: enters at left border frame 17 (~(13,564)), arcs up-right (highest in image ~y 239 at frame 27), comes down to floor bounce at frame 37 (696,492), then travels up-right (away) to (832,300) at frame 48, nearly stopped

white_ball.desc: small off-white/light-grey ball (with a darker patch) thrown with the yellow ball, similar size, leads it
white_ball.path: appears at (211,445) frame 20 beside the thrower's hand, arcs up-right (highest ~y 195 frames 27-28), floor bounce at frame 38 (680,467), then travels up-right to (791,261) at frame 47; hidden behind the green object on the floor at frame 48

crouching_person.desc: person at bottom right (light-green silhouette, ~x 910-1140, y 520-720) who holds and pushes the basketball and releases the soccer ball

thrower_arm.desc: arm/hand entering from the left edge (~x 0-250, y 330-600) during frames ~17-30 that throws the yellow and white balls

seated_person.desc: person seated at a desk/workbench top right (~x 880-1030, y 40-270), essentially static

waste_bin.desc: small cyan/blue recycling bin against the back wall

tripod.desc: light stand / tripod left of the bin

floor_tape_marks.desc: two thin lime-green strips on the carpet

cabinet_doors_and_outlets.desc: tall dark cabinet/locker doors along the back-left wall; two wall outlets at ~(130,240) and ~(200,230)

floor_items_near_desk.desc: green object (~x 770-830, y 205-245) and blue item (~x 800-830, y 245-265) on the floor by the desk; cables on the floor

events.what: basketball starts moving (pushed by the crouching person's hand)
basketball free of the hand (arm no longer crossing it); rolls on the floor afterwards
yellow ball enters at left image border (thrown)
white ball first visible, beside the thrower's hand (released ~frame 19-20)
soccer ball starts rolling (released by the crouching person; held static frames 0-23)
yellow ball floor bounce (lowest image point (696,492))
white ball floor bounce (lowest image point (680,467))
basketball reaches the back wall/baseboard and reverses (closest approach (400,265)); rebounds slowly afterwards
soccer ball rendering drops to a flat grey disc (segmentation artefact, ball still there)
white ball hidden behind floor items; all balls except possibly the yellow are still moving at the end

track_columns: frame,t,x,y (reference point = visible ball centre),ref (mask_centroid or circle_fit),bbox_x0..y1,bbox_w,bbox_h,len_major,wid_minor (mask extents along/across its main axis),major_angle_deg,diam_est (wid_minor, or 2*circle radius when occluded),area,occluded,blur,note
